recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source edit is needed for FHIR-25258 unless a future work group decision changes the type or semantics of DeviceRequest.quantity.
issue_request: FHIR-25258 was a Published/Persuasive OO change request asking DeviceRequest to indicate the number of devices being requested because the R4 resource lacked a quantity field comparable to other request resources.
initial_application: The request appears to have been applied by commit 9da8d6fa1710935ded8bb20e4a2532aeb7b88c99, whose message listed 25258 and whose patch added DeviceRequest.quantity to source/devicerequest/structuredefinition-DeviceRequest.xml. Later diagram cleanup reflected the same element in source/devicerequest/devicerequest.svg.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists DeviceRequest as an active resource, and current source/devicerequest/structuredefinition-DeviceRequest.xml defines DeviceRequest.quantity as an optional integer with definition "The number of devices to be provided." Zulip and Confluence evidence shows FHIR-25258 was part of the OO Healthcare Product DeviceRequest block vote, with the 2020-01-23 Confluence minutes recording approval 12-0-1. Jira/source/community searches did not reveal a later conflicting core DeviceRequest quantity decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the authoritative current source already satisfies the requested DeviceRequest quantity support.
